_note: Everything asserted here runs on `oc logs` alone, which needs no log store — deliberate, because CRC cannot host a LokiStack (too heavy) and the aggregation half of the lab is therefore taught rather than run. The page says so in a warning rather than pretending. verify-logs-gone-with-pod asserts an ABSENCE: after the crashing Deployment is deleted, oc logs must have nothing left to read — that is the lab's closing point.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=240s
url="http://hello-dcs.$(oc project -q).svc:8080"; oc apply -f service.yaml; for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null "$url" 2>/dev/null; done; echo sent 20
envsubst < crashing.yaml | oc apply -f - && sleep 30 && oc get pods -l app=flaky
pod=$(oc get pods -l app=flaky -o name | head -1); oc logs "$pod" --previous --tail=20 || true
